snippet.title: Pizzoccheri alla valtellinese 🧀🥬 #chefmaxmariola
snippet.description:
Ragazzi, oggi vi porto in Valtellina con un piatto della tradizione che è una vera bomba di gusto! 🤤🔥

Ho preparato i pizzoccheri fatti in casa, impastando farina di grano saraceno e farina di grano tenero. Li ho poi cotti nella stessa acqua in cui avevo già sbollentato le patate e la verza, tagliate grossolane. 🥔🥬

Poi ho messo tutto in una pirofila, aggiungendo il Casera semistagionato e il grana grattugiato. 
E per finire? Una bella sferzatura di burro caldo aromatizzato con aglio e salvia! 🧈😍

snippet.title: Are old Supercars RUBBISH? V12 Lambo v 7-seat Volvo DRAG RACE!
snippet.description:
Are old supercars pointless?! 

Explore new and used car deals with Carwow: https://bit.ly/Change-Your-Car-021026

Is this one of the weirdest line-ups we’ve ever had on the channel?

We’ve got our hands on one of the all-time great Lamborghinis - the Murciélago LP640. And it’s lining up against… a Volvo EX90?! 

You may think this race is completely pointless, pitting a 7-seat family SUV against a classic supercar. But these cars are actually more closely matched than you may think! Let’s take a closer look at the stats… 

Starting with the Lambo, it’s powered by a 6.5-litre naturally aspirated V12, which produces 640hp and 660Nm of torque. This power is sent to all four wheels via a 6-speed gearbox, and it tips the scales at 1,765kg. As of today, it’s worth about £500,000, and it was released way back in 2007. 

Then we come to the Volvo EX90. It’s an all-electric, family-friendly SUV, and it’s packing two electric motors which combine to produce 680hp and 870Nm. Given it has two motors, it comes with all-wheel drive, but it’s mighty heavy, weighing in at 2,725kg! It’s also a whole lot cheaper than the Lambo, costing £98,160. 

So how will this one play out? The Lambo weighs a tonne less than the Volvo, but will the extra power from the electric motors prove decisive? There’s only one way to find out for sure… LET’S RACE!

Thanks to James for joining us for this drag race:

snippet.title: NGỒI CÀNG LÂU, LƯNG CÀNG CỨNG VÀ ĐAU? | THE LONGER YOU SIT, THE STIFFER YOUR BACK FEELS? TRY THESE 3
snippet.description:
💥BACK PAIN, STIFF BACK & ROUNDED SHOULDERS? 

Do you often feel back stiffness, aching around your spine, or notice your shoulders rolling forward and your upper back becoming rounded?

Long hours of sitting, poor movement habits, and looking down frequently can contribute to back tension and slouched posture.

🧘 Try these 3 gentle exercises to:

✨ Release tension and stiffness in your back
✨ Stretch tight muscles along your back and chest
✨ Improve spinal mobility and upper-body flexibility
✨ Support better posture and a more upright position

Hold each stretch for 10–15 seconds per side, repeating for 2–3 sets.

Move slowly, breathe naturally, and stay within your comfortable range. Never force your back into a deeper stretch or push through pain.

📌 Save this routine and follow @YogaWithLio for more gentle exercises you can do at home!

⸻

💥ĐAU LƯNG, CỨNG LƯNG, KHOM GÙ VAI? 

Bạn thường xuyên cảm thấy lưng căng cứng, đau mỏi dọc cột sống hoặc nhận thấy vai ngày càng cuộn về phía trước, lưng trên khom gù?

Ngồi lâu, ít vận động và thường xuyên cúi người có thể khiến các nhóm cơ vùng lưng căng mỏi, đồng thời ảnh hưởng đến tư thế của bạn.

🧘 Thử ngay 3 bài tập nhẹ nhàng giúp:

✨ Thả lỏng vùng lưng căng cứng, đau mỏi
✨ Kéo giãn các nhóm cơ vùng lưng và ngực
✨ Cải thiện độ linh hoạt của cột sống và thân trên
✨ Hỗ trợ cải thiện tư thế, giúp bạn giữ dáng đứng thẳng và thoải mái hơn

Giữ mỗi tư thế 10–15 giây mỗi bên, lặp lại 2–3 hiệp.

Tập chậm rãi, hít thở đều và chỉ kéo giãn trong phạm vi thoải mái. Không cố ép lưng hoặc tiếp tục nếu cảm thấy đau.

📌 Lưu video để tập mỗi ngày và theo dõi @YogaWithLio để chăm sóc cột sống, cải thiện tư thế nhé!

snippet.title: खुशिया बाँटने से बढ़ती है  #emotional
snippet.description:
Krishna Bhajan | Radhe Krishna Song | Bhakti Song 2025 | Shri Krishna Devotional Video

🙏 जय श्री कृष्णा 🙏
स्वागत है आपका हमारे भक्ति परिवार में।
इस वीडियो में सुनिए एक मधुर श्रीकृष्ण भजन,
जो आपके मन को शांति, भक्ति और आनंद से भर देगा।
हमारा उद्देश्य है कि हर दिल में “राधे कृष्ण” का प्रेम बहे
और हर घर में भक्ति की गूंज सुनाई दे।


---

🎶 कृष्ण भजन का महत्व

श्रीकृष्ण करुणा, प्रेम और धर्म के प्रतीक हैं।
उनके भजन सुनने या गाने से —

मन शांत होता है 🕊️

आत्मा पवित्र होती है 🌸

जीवन में सकारात्मकता आती है ✨

और हृदय में प्रेम बढ़ता है 💖



---

📿 हरे कृष्ण महामंत्र

"हरे कृष्ण हरे कृष्ण, कृष्ण कृष्ण हरे हरे।
हरे राम हरे राम, राम राम हरे हरे।।"

इस मंत्र के जाप से मन स्थिर होता है और आत्मा को दिव्यता का अनुभव मिलता है।
यह मंत्र हमें ईश्वर से जोड़ने का सबसे सरल मार्ग है।


---

🌺 कृष्ण की लीलाएँ

बाल्यकाल की माखन चोरी से लेकर
कालिया नाग मर्दन और अर्जुन को गीता उपदेश देने तक —
हर लीला हमें जीवन का संदेश देती है कि
भक्ति में ही सच्ची शक्ति छिपी है।


---

🎼 हमारे भजन संग्रह

👉 Krishna Bhajan
👉 Radhe Krishna Song
👉 Govinda Naam Sankirtan
👉 Bhakti Geet
👉 Hare Krishna Mantra

हर भजन आपको श्रीकृष्ण के प्रेम में डुबो देता है और मन को शांत करता है।


---

🌸 भक्ति का मार्ग

भक्ति वह सरल मार्ग है जो सीधा भगवान तक ले जाता है।
जब हम सच्चे मन से कृष्ण का नाम लेते हैं,
तो दुख दूर होकर जीवन में नई रोशनी आती है।


---

💫 हमारा उद्देश्य

हम चाहते हैं कि हर घर में “हरे कृष्ण” का नाम गूंजे।
इसलिए हम रोज़ाना नए-नए भजन और कीर्तन प्रस्तुत करते हैं।
अगर आपको यह वीडियो पसंद आए तो —

✔️ वीडियो को Like करें

snippet.title: Mẹ Thúy Diễm từ Ý về lo đầy tháng cháu, bù đắp con gái vắng cha
snippet.description:
Câu chuyện gia đình của diễn viên Thúy Diễm lại một lần nữa khiến cộng đồng mạng rưng rưng xúc động khi hé lộ hành trình yêu thương đầy trọn vẹn. Ở tuổi 40, nữ diễn viên chính thức đón công chúa nhỏ Rosie chào đời, hoàn thành trọn vẹn giấc mơ đủ nếp đủ tẻ bên ông xã Lương Thế Thành. Nhưng điều khiến người xem nghẹn ngào hơn cả chính là bóng dáng người mẹ ruột năm nay 65 tuổi. Dù đang sinh sống tại Italy, bà đã gác lại mọi bộn bề, tức tốc vượt nửa vòng trái đất để trở về Việt Nam, dự định ở lại suốt 6 tháng để trực tiếp chăm lo cho con gái cưng trong giai đoạn ở cữ.

snippet.title: I Tested Carhartt, Walmart, Costco & L.L.Bean Winter Jackets at 0°F — Not Even Close!
snippet.description:
📖 I've camped for more than fifty years, and I put all of it in one book: https://ivansoutdoors.com

Go find the tag on your winter coat. If it says 650 fill, that number isn't a warmth rating. If it says Level 4 Extreme Warmth, that isn't a temperature. I read both of them wrong for longer than I'd like to admit.

For most of my life my rule was simple. Heavier is warmer, pricier is warmer, and a big name on the chest means somebody already tested it so I don't have to. That rule failed me more than once, and never the way the tag warned about. The coat felt warm in the store and warm on the walk to the truck. Then the wind came across the lake.

So I laid four jackets across the tailgate on a zero-degree morning. The twenty-eight dollar Ozark Trail Men's Puffer from Walmart. An Eddie Bauer hooded down jacket from Costco for about forty. The Carhartt Yukon Extremes Insulated Parka. And the L.L.Bean Baxter State Parka. Same wool base layer, same fleece, same folding camp chair out in the open, one jacket per session, and a full warm-up in the running truck between them.

In still air, the gap between forty dollars and three hundred felt surprisingly small. Then a steady fifteen mile an hour wind showed up, and that's where the title stopped being a figure of speech. After that I shoveled the plow pile for twenty minutes, and the jacket that fell apart in the wind turned out to be the best one to work in.

What we go through:

Why 650 fill measures loft and not warmth, and the second number almost nobody prints Why sewn-through seams can feel like pencils laid across your back Sitting still at zero, where the coat does almost all the work The four Carhartt warmth levels, and why Carhartt says they aren't defined by temperature Same Yukon Extremes name, same Level 4 badge, and less than half the insulation Why Thinsulate Featherless isn't down, and when synthetic has the advantage What fifteen miles an hour does to a zero-degree morning Why the shell mattered more than the insulation Shoveling, sweat, and the clammy chill when you sit back down The cheap way to close the gap with a windproof shell you already own Waterproof against water-repellent, and which coats I'd drag through brush What long-time owners say about the newer Baxter Which coat for errands, which for work, and which for the ice or the deer stand

Straight talk on safety: this is one man, one body, and a few cold mornings, not a lab, so don't copy it as an endurance contest. I had the truck running twenty feet away, somebody checking on me, my face covered, and a firm rule that numb fingers or shivering I couldn't stop meant the round was over. At zero degrees with a fifteen mile an hour wind, the National Weather Service puts the wind chill at nineteen below and says exposed skin can freeze in about thirty minutes.

Everything decades of cold mornings have taught me about layering, gear, and staying safe outside went into my book. You'll find it at ivansoutdoors.com.

Before you spend the money, skip the question of which jacket is warmest. Ask what you're going to be doing while you wear it.

Tell me in the comments: what's the coldest you've ever been in a coat that was supposed to be warm, and which coat was it? And if you own any of these four, tell me what I'm missing.
